exec: pm.test("Role is USER and token returned", () => { pm.expect(j.role).to.eql("USER"); pm.expect(j.token).to.be.a("string"); });

item.name: Create show - time in the past (400)

exec: pm.test("Contains the new booking", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(b => b.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("bookingId"))).to.be.true);
pm.test("Now CANCELLED and refunded", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("CANCELLED"); pm.expect(b.paymentStatus).to.eql("REFUNDED"); });
